product: IFFCO Tokio Marine Cargo Policy (public wording)
clause: F.A.S. ATTACHMENT CLAUSE: Notwithstanding anything contained herein to the contrary, the risks covered hereunder shall not attach until the title of the interest hereby insured is duly vested in the assured alongside the overseas vessel at the port of shipment under their F.A.S. contract with the shipper.
question: Does my marine cargo cover start the moment I buy the goods, or only once title passes at the overseas port?
gold_rationale: Under the F.A.S. Attachment Clause, the risks do not attach until title of the insured interest is duly vested in the assured alongside the overseas vessel at the port of shipment, so cover is conditional on title vesting at that point.
expected_citation: risks covered hereunder shall not attach

product: IFFCO Tokio Marine Cargo Policy (public wording)
clause: Absolutely: (1) Any expenses incurred in consequence of or to prevent or mitigate pollution or contamination or any threat or liability therefor. (2) the cost of removal of cargo from any vessel or craft.
question: Are the costs of cleaning up pollution or removing cargo from a vessel covered under this marine policy?
gold_rationale: Expenses to prevent or mitigate pollution/contamination and the cost of removal of cargo from any vessel or craft are expressly excluded (stated 'Absolutely'), with no carve-back, so they are not covered.
expected_citation: Any expenses incurred in consequence of or to prevent or mitigate pollution

product: IFFCO Tokio Marine Cargo Policy (public wording)
clause: GENERAL AVERAGE: The holder of this Policy is requested not to sign any Average Bond or to pay and deposit on account of General Average without first communicating with the Company.
question: If a general average is declared, can I just pay the average bond myself?
gold_rationale: On a general average, the insured is required to communicate with the Company before signing any Average Bond or paying/depositing on account of General Average, so the insured's action is conditional on that communication.
expected_citation: not to sign any Average Bond or to pay and deposit on account of General Average

product: IFFCO Tokio Marine Cargo Policy (public wording)
clause: BASIS OF VALUATION: The shipments insured hereunder are to be valued, premium included, at the amount of invoice including all charges noted in the invoice and including prepaid and/or guaranteed freight as agreed unless otherwise declared to the Company prior to shipment and prior to any known or reported loss and then at the amount declared.
question: How is the value of my cargo calculated for a claim under this policy?
gold_rationale: Cargo is valued at invoice amount plus charges (premium included) unless otherwise declared to the Company prior to shipment and prior to any known/reported loss, so the valuation is conditional on the declaration timing.
